#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

bool can(int v, const string& s) {
    string ss = to_string(v);
    char king_me = '?';
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ss.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] != '_' && s[i] != 'X') {
            if (s[i] != ss[i]) return false;
        } else if (s[i] == '_') {
            continue;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X') {
            if (king_me != '?' && ss[i] != king_me) return false;
            else if (king_me == '?') king_me = ss[i];
            else continue;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int len = s.length();
    long long max_val = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) max_val *= 10;
    max_val -= 1;
    long long min_val = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < len - 1; i++) min_val *= 10;
    if (min_val == 1) min_val--;
    if (s[0] == '0' && s.length() > 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (long long i = min_val; i <= max_val; i++) {
        if (i % 25 == 0) {
            if (can((int)i, s)) ans++;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
